title: Director of Data
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure&nbsp;</strong>for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.<br><br>Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.<br><br>Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.<br><br><strong>Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.</strong><br><br><strong>Our Team Members:</strong></p> <p>We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!<br><br>We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.</p></div><p><strong>Your Role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Head of Data to lead Alpaca’s ~15-person data department across Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science. You will own the data strategy, the team’s execution, and the department’s roadmap.</p> <p>The Data department serves every function at Alpaca: it powers partner invoicing and revenue attribution, provides the analytical foundation for sales, product, and compliance, and operates the data platform that processes hundreds of millions of events daily. You will manage three team leads, balancing operational delivery (invoicing, embedded analytics, regulatory reporting) with strategic bets (self-service warehouse, AI-powered analytics, enterprise search).</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. You will set direction for the team while staying close enough to the technical details to make architecture decisions, unblock your leads, and represent data’s capabilities to the executive team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>Things You Get To Do:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead and develop three sub-teams: Platform Engineering &amp; ETL, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science &amp; Analytics. Manage leads, set priorities, and ensure delivery.</li> <li>Own the Data Lakehouse architecture: Trino, Iceberg/GCS, Airflow, Airbyte, Redpanda CDC, dbt. Make build-vs-buy decisions on tooling.</li> <li>Drive partner invoicing accuracy and evolution: ensure invoicing logic is versioned, reproducible, and scales with new pricing mechanisms and product launches.</li> <li>Deliver embedded analytics: expose warehouse data to partners via BrokerDash, SSR pipelines, and API-based reporting. Own row-level security and entitlements.</li> <li>Support product launches with data change management: coordinate data impact analysis for new products (fixed income, global stocks, perps, 24/5 trading) across downstream datasets, dashboards, and reverse ETL.</li> <li>Accelerate self-service: move the organization toward self-serve analytics via semantic layers, data catalogues, and conversational BI so the data team can shift from ad-hoc queries to strategic projects.</li> <li>Guide AI/ML enablement: oversee enterprise AI search, agent-based workflow automation, and LLM-powered analytics. Help balance vendor solutions with in-house development.</li> <li>Collaborate with Finance, Sales, Product, Compliance, and Customer Success to translate business needs into data products.</li> <li>Manage infrastructure costs: keep data + cloud cost ratio under target as AUC grows.</li> <li>Operate production systems: own on-call processes, incident response, and SLOs for data freshness, accuracy, and availability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Must-Haves):</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years in data engineering or analytics, including 3+ years managing data teams (leads + ICs).</li> <li>Deep experience with modern data stack: dbt, Trino/Presto or equivalent query engines, Apache Iceberg or similar table formats, cloud object storage.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT patterns at scale: CDC (Debezium/Kafka), batch (Airflow/dbt), streaming, and reverse ETL.</li> <li>Track record of building self-service analytics capabilities for non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with financial data: trading, invoicing, revenue attribution, or regulatory reporting in fintech or financial services.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and SQL. Comfortable reading code, reviewing PRs, and making architecture decisions.</li> <li>Experience managing distributed/remote teams across multiple time zones.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management: you can translate between executive priorities and engineering execution.</li> <li>Experience with GCP (GKE, GCS, BigQuery migration), Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with brokerage or broker-dealer operations (clearing, settlement, market making, reconciliation).</li> <li>Familiarity with LLM/AI tooling: MCP, vector databases, enterprise search, conversational BI (WrenAI, Cube).</li> <li>Background in compliance analytics (AML/Actimize, KYC, margin calls).</li> <li>Exposure to open-source data catalogues (OpenMetadata, Collate) and data quality frameworks.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>How We Take Care of You:</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive Salary &amp; Stock Options</span></li> <li style="text-align: justify;">Health Benefits</li> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card</span></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.<br></span></em></p> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><a href="https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/AlpacaRecruitmentPrivacyPolicy.pdf"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recruitment Privacy Policy</span></em></a></span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Account Director
raw.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does an Account Director do at WPP Production?

The role

Our Account Director (AD) are knowledgeable and trusted Client leads.  Accountable for end-to-end project delivery, management of client and agency relationships, they lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver. Responsible for operational discipline, delivery, resource optimisation and profitability management across Clients and projects. You are the key point person for the projects you are leading and are responsible for delivering on time, on specification and on budget.

You possess problem-solving skills, have a passion for production, marketing and advertising and a desire to learn. Highly organised and accountable, you build trusting Client and team relationships, collaborate across multi-disciplined teams and draw on the expertise of Hogarth's resources and capabilities. You are ensure we execute flawlessly.

Key areas of responsibility

Communication

  • Responsible for managing the day to day client relationship with a focus on Client delivery
  • Oversee the on-time delivery of projects and ensure the smooth delivery and swift resolution of issues to maintain client confidence in WPP capabilities to deliver
  • The key day-to-day Client Delivery contact with clients, agencies and all associated WPP Production teams
  • Understanding of client's needs to deliver high satisfaction levels and share feedback with wider team and escalate any delivery concerns to Senior Account Director / Client Director
  • Act as the primary client contact for project delivery, structuring regular status and communications with clients, defining scope and approach, setting and managing expectations and deliverables and troubleshooting issues as they arise
  • Work with client brands and agencies to ensure a clear understanding of the production brief, deliverables and timeline for each project and relay those details to other members of the team as necessary
  • Accountable for ensuring all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables

Collaboration

  • Partner with Client Services, Production and Finance to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation and a superior result
  • Develop and maintain high levels of team effectiveness, trust, communication, collaboration, productivity, diversity, engagement and ensure the team feel personal accountability for deliverables and projects
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration skills with internal agency teams and key external partners to ensure quality and adherence to production guidelines for key deliverables

Process

  • Manage medium to complex projects independently and with a team, from initiation through to completion
  • Work collaboratively with all internal team members to facilitate the process of developing effective strategies and briefs that lead to great work
  • Understand and anticipate client needs, taking them into account when framing and making delivery decisions
  • Possess an understanding of project and client management techniques and bring process innovation to how we manage our engagements
  • Manage client objectives, budget, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicate changes/direction to team members
  • Keep projects on track through clear team status, task lists, timing schedules, risk register, trackers, status and contact reports
  • Participate actively and knowledgeably articulate status internally and during client interactions
  • Leverage our on-site, onshore, offshore network to deliver great work in the most efficient and effective way
  • Identify improvements to existing workflow and processes
  • Identify potential project risks and develop contingency plans and if needed, escalate to Senior Account Director / Client Director
  • Review team structure and resources on an ongoing basis to ensure client is serviced appropriately
  • Ensure the highest quality is always delivered to clients

Leadership

  • Create a culture of fresh-thinking, collaboration, respect, equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on learning, development and growth
  • Contribute to WPP Productions culture by exhibiting ownership, professionalism, passion and leading by example
  • Take ownership and find solutions, whilst supporting the wider team by removing any barriers to success
  • Retain the best talent

Financials

  • Demonstrate strong commercial abilities and business and financial acumen
  • Own project budgets and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients
  • Manage POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets
  • Manage financial aspects of assigned accounts including development of SOW and change orders, estimates, profitability analysis, and utilisation, working with Finance where appropriate
  • Responsible for monthly billing and tracking of all production budgets
  • Ensure a thorough understanding of commercial arrangements, and SLA's across assigned accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the broader team
  • Protect margins
  • Proactively seek and identify new revenue opportunities across your clients

Requirements

  • Project / Client management related experience within an interactive or integrated agency, with a good understanding of marketing and production implementation processes across all key channels, including digital, video, content, social etc
  • Good understanding of production and the creative development process, content production, technology, quality assurance testing and marketing methodologies
  • Ability to manage complex projects with varying components, demonstrating ability to deliver on time and on budget
  • Experience of building solid client relationships
  • A professional, calm, approachable demeanour, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic highly matrixed agency environment
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and relationships cross functionally
  • An appreciation for how great work gets done and a commitment to ensuring flawless execution and delivery
  • Proven ability to collaborate with dynamic cross-functional teams to deliver on projects
  • Demonstrates an ability to solve problems with the solution that works for all stakeholders without compromising the quality of the deliverables or the project
  • Must be commercially astute able to build scopes, create budgets and track profitability
  • Proven negotiation skills
  • Strong client relationship skills including presenting to clients and the ability to think on your feet
  • Strong written/oral communication skills
  • Experience of working with offshore teams a plus
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, wireframing/workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Smartsheet, Trello, Miro etc

#LI-PS1

At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

The Customer Relationship team is accountable for retaining existing business and driving sales growth through client adoption of Company products and services. Clients include media agencies, platforms, direct brands, and other AdTech vendors. 

They specialize in using deep industry, business processes and product expertise to increase product adoption and utilization. Post-sale client point of contact accountable for value driven engagements across the customer retention lifecycle resulting in client renewals. May handle escalations and coordinate across other functional areas of the Company.

 

Essential Key Responsibilities
  • Serves as the primary post-sale point of contact to top‑tier or highly complex accounts, working with full autonomy, navigating multiple buying centers, senior client leadership, and cross‑market or cross-platform strategies.
  • Develop and execute long-range account strategies that align with client business goals and drive sustainable, multi-dimensional revenue growth.
  • Lead high‑stakes, executive‑level conversations and negotiations, influencing senior client leadership to advance partnership priorities.
  • Identify non-obvious growth opportunities, including cross-solution expansion, new platform integrations, and strategic pilot initiatives.
  • Delivers significant revenue expansion across strategic, high-value accounts.
  • Represent client perspectives to influence product positioning and roadmap adoption.
  • Mentors junior level team members, elevating account management standards and contributing to overall team effectiveness.
  • Monitor client usage data, health indicators, renewal dates, and growth opportunities and translate them into strategies for success
  • Carry out regular account management activity to “Protect” existing accounts. Proactively identify accounts at risk of churn and implement retention strategies.
  • Coordinate with implementation teams to ensure solution delivery meets or exceeds contracted SLAs and KPIs
  • Additional duties as assigned.

  • Minimum of eight (8) years in a post-sale client management experience leading a portfolio of high touch enterprise and/or strategic accounts
  • Proven experience in digital advertising, audience data, AdTech, or media sales.

  • Strong strategic thinking and planning. Ability to apply forward‑looking judgment to shape multi‑year client strategies and guide complex decision pathways.
  • High‑level commercial insight, evaluating market dynamics, client business models, and emerging opportunities to drive multi‑dimensional revenue growth.
  • Strong consultative selling skills. Ability to frame problems effectively, proposing strategic solutions, and guiding clients toward transformational initiatives.

As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.</p> <p>Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><div> <h2>Principal Medical Writer</h2> <div> <p>Our <strong>Principals</strong> play a fundamental role in shaping individual projects within an account with the support and direction of others. They co-lead the creation of outstanding medical content across various therapy areas and provide strategic insights to elevate client deliverables. This position is ideal for a proactive communicator who enjoys managing writing teams, ensuring quality and accuracy, and acting as a primary contact for clients. Our Principals have the opportunity to specialise in content development, team leadership, and/or strategic thinking.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <p>All Principals share the following core responsibilities</p> <ul> <li><strong>Therapy area and scientific expertise:</strong> Co-lead development of high-quality medical content under senior direction across multiple therapy areas and initiatives to meet/exceed client expectations</li> <li><strong>Strategic thinking:</strong> <ul> <li>Provide strategic input to aligned accounts</li> <li>Demonstrate confidence and competent in questioning to probe and understand client briefs and distill for Real Chemistry teams</li> <li>Adopt a questioning mindset to scientifically and strategically challenge and elevate outputs with clients and internal teams</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>AI: </strong>Co-lead implementation of AI into new projects and initiatives under senior direction within an account</li> <li><strong>Client relationships:</strong> Act as day-to-day medical contact for clients</li> <li><strong>Managing and advising:</strong> <ul> <li>Manage and mentor junior individuals and teams to work competently, confidently and efficiently to deliver high-quality work in high-pressure situations</li> <li>Be responsible for guaranteeing the accuracy and quality of assets and that they are crafted and delivered in line with client objectives and expectations</li> <li>Delegate work within account to ensure everyone is hitting billable targets and learning through new opportunitiesThe Principal, Medical Content additionally has the following responsibilities</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Project expertise:</strong> Co-lead excellent medical content across a broad range of deliverables, demonstrating versatility</li> <li><strong>Content excellence:</strong> <ul> <li>Uphold and advocate for the highest standards in medical writing within accounts</li> <li>Identify the most appropriate channel, style and format for a project to achieve client objectives and maximise engagement</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Quality standards:</strong> <ul> <li>Uphold the highest standards within accounts</li> <li>Advocate for best practices in project management and delivery to maintain the highest content&nbsp; quality within account</li> <li>Lead development of knowledge training for junior members within account</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>The Principal, Medical Team additionally has the following responsibilities</p> <ul> <li><strong>Coaching and mentoring:</strong> <ul> <li>Provide coaching and mentorship to JMWs/MWS/SMWs</li> <li>Coordinate specialised mentorship programs for JMWs</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Overarching planning to meet KPIs/timelines/budget: </strong> <ul> <li>Manage and prioritise competing workloads within the account, fostering a comprehensive understanding of the team's projects</li> <li>Be responsible for guaranteeing that assets are crafted and delivered in line with KPIs, timelines, and budget constraints</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Financial and resource management</strong> <ul> <li>Define and organise resource distribution within accounts to facilitate strategic succession planning and to optimise the alignment of medical colleagues' skills and capacity with account requirements</li> <li>Participate in general financial oversight of the account</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>The Medical Strategist additionally has the following responsibilities</p> <ul> <li><strong>Business development:</strong> <ul> <li>Support definition/shape of strategy on new business proposals and pitches</li> <li>Contribute to identification of opportunities for organic growth through participating in key engagements</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Strategic leadership: </strong> <ul> <li>Support the shaping and execution of strategy for projects in collaboration with medical writing and client service teams and key strategic contact</li> <li>Act as knowledge partner by confidently engaging with clients to exchange ideas, create options etc in conjunction with medical writing and accounts teams</li> <li>Provide input on how a scientific evidence-base can shape a brand’s go-to market strategy, positioning, evidence generation and medical communication strategy</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Critical thinking: </strong> <ul> <li>Identify key actionable insights, recommendations, opportunities, threats, and critical success factors to inform product strategies</li> <li>Shape and structure meetings/workshops to support decision-making</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>Qualifications and Skills</h2> <ul> <li>You should bring previous experience of medical writing at an SMW level or above</li> <li>Previous experience managing medical writers and interacting regularly with clients is essential</li> <li>A profound understanding of healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential</li> <li>A high level of academic achievement is expected</li> <li>You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and capable of nurturing relationships</li> </ul> <h2>What Real Chemistry offers</h2> </div> <p>Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities.&nbsp;While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.</p> <p>Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. regulated sector customers, accelerating deal cycles, and reinforcing the integrity of our UK Sovereign security program.</p> <h4>How will you make an impact?</h4> <h2>Customer Trust &amp; Security Engagement</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor: </strong>Serve as the primary point of contact for UK Sovereign customers on all matters related to security posture, vulnerabilities, remediation activities, and trust documentation.</li> <li><strong>Security Questionnaires: </strong>Support end-to-end responses to customer and prospect security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, VSA, MoD/UK government questionnaires, and bespoke enterprise formats), ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent answers tailored to UK Sovereign context.</li> <li><strong>Responder: </strong>Help respond to inbound timelines.</li> <li><strong>Monthly Customer Reporting: </strong>help prepare and<strong> </strong>deliver monthly security status updates to UK Sovereign customers, including progress on scheduled remediation items and key security metrics.</li> <li><strong>Remediation Oversight: </strong>Monitor and track remediation activities across engineering and security teams, ensuring alignment with agreed timelines and compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <h2>Audit</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Audit Interpretation: </strong>Read and interpret third-party audit reports (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, penetration test summaries) and represent findings to customers in questionnaires and security responses.</li> </ul> <h2>Communication &amp; Stakeholder Management</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Information Translation: </strong>Gather detailed technical information from engineering and security teams, then convert and filter it into clear, concise, and structured updates accessible to both technical experts and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Customer Meetings: </strong>participate in security review meetings, capture feedback and action items, and ensure timely follow-up and and operational reality.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Citizenship &amp; Clearance: </strong>UK citizenship and ability to pass and maintain SC clearance.</li> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>5+ years in a security, GRC, trust, or technical customer-facing role, with direct ownership of security questionnaires, customer inquiries, and security reporting.</li> <li><strong>Questionnaire Expertise: </strong>Hands-on experience responding to SIG, CAIQ, VSA, and bespoke enterprise/government security questionnaires.</li> <li><strong>Compliance Knowledge: </strong>Working knowledge of Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and at least one of PCI DSS, GDPR/UK GDPR, HIPAA, or FedRAMP.</li> <li><strong>Technical Expertise: </strong>Strong technical understanding of security principles, architecture, and vulnerability management, including access control, encryption, incident response, network security, and secure SDLC.</li> <li><strong>Cloud &amp; SaaS: </strong>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security models.</li> <li><strong>Communication: stakeholders).</li> <li><strong>Customer Relations: </strong>Proven experience in customer-facing roles within security or technology sectors, ideally including regulated or government customers.</li> integrity and discretion.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Professional cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSK, ISO 27001 Job description

We are looking for a Senior AI-Native Fullstack Engineer with a DevOps focus to support multiple engineering projects across AI-powered applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud-native solutions. This is not a traditional DevOps-only role. The role combines application engineering with infrastructure ownership: building services, APIs, automation and internal tools, while also running cloud infrastructure, deployments, observability and production operations.

The ideal profile is a strong fullstack or backend engineer, preferably TypeScript-heavy, with hands-on depth in AWS, Infrastructure as Code, containers, networking, permissions, secrets and observability. With modern AI and LLM tooling, repetitive engineering, infrastructure, debugging and automation work can be accelerated dramatically. We expect someone who uses AI-native workflows to investigate in parallel, generate and validate infrastructure changes, and support teams with high-quality execution.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a builder who can move across the full delivery chain: application code, infrastructure code, deployment, runtime configuration and production troubleshooting. You should be someone who:

  • Builds application software and owns the infrastructure behind it
  • Uses AI as a default development and troubleshooting workflow
  • Cares about reliability, security, automation, observability and maintainability
  • Chooses simple solutions, owns outcomes, and verifies aggressively


Your tasks

  • Fullstack Engineering: Build services, APIs, scripts, automation, internal tools and lightweight frontend functionality where useful, mainly in TypeScript
  • Infrastructure & Cloud Setup: Use IaC, ideally AWS CDK, to build pragmatic cloud patterns across containers, databases, queues, storage, networking, DNS, secrets and runtime configuration
  • ECS Fargate Operations: Deploy and troubleshoot ECS Fargate workloads, including task definitions, services, load balancers, IAM roles, logs, scaling and deployment behavior
  • Security, Observability & Troubleshooting: Handle IAM, least privilege, secrets, logs, metrics, alarms, failed deployments, configuration issues, networking problems and runtime incidents


Your profile

AI-Native Development & Operations

  • Hands-on use of Claude Code, Codex or similar advanced AI tools; Copilot-style autocomplete is not enough
  • Uses agents for development, infrastructure changes, debugging and operational investigation, while strongly reviewing and testing AI-generated code, scripts and configuration
Fullstack / Software Engineering
  • Strong fullstack or backend engineering experience, especially with TypeScript; able to build production services, APIs, scripts, tools and automation
  • Comfortable across application code, infrastructure code, deployments and runtime systems, from problem clarification to production rollout
Cloud, IaC & DevOps Operations
  • Strong IaC and AWS or similar cloud experience, ideally AWS CDK with TypeScript, across containers, ECS Fargate, networking, IAM, secrets, DNS, storage, databases, queues and runtime configuration
  • Strong observability, security and delivery judgment: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alarms, least privilege, deployment safety, pipeline permissions and safe developer access
  • Pragmatic production debugger with good judgment on scalability, availability, cost, security, operational trade-offs and clear English communication
Good Fit
You may be a good fit if you are a fullstack/backend or TypeScript engineer with strong AWS, IaC and DevOps experience; a DevOps/platform or SRE-minded engineer with real software engineering depth; or an AI-native builder using LLMs and agents daily for real development and infrastructure work.

Not a Good Fit
This role is probably not the right fit if you are mainly an infrastructure admin who avoids coding, a pipeline-only DevOps profile, a pure application developer with no cloud ownership, someone who only wants predefined tickets, or someone who does not actively use and validate AI-generated infrastructure, scripts and configuration.


Your benefits

  • Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
  • Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership
  • Individual development opportunities, structured onboarding, and interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Flexible working models including hybrid work, home office, and mobile working
  • A modern tech environment and agile ways of working
  • Additional benefits such as pension plans, health offers, and employee discounts

title: Senior RF Engineer II
description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a  Senior RF Engineer II  to our team. The ideal candidate has experience in board-level RF electronics design. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge RF hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.   In this position, you will be responsible for RF circuits and systems through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be proficient in board-level schematic design and PCB layout of RF circuits, and system-level communications concepts such as link budgets and modulation schemes. The work will include many aspects of phased array communication systems, including RF front-ends, frequency converters and synthesizers, filters, beamformers, power dividers, and phased array antennas.   As a Cesium hardware team member, you will be responsible for RF hardware designs from initial concept through requirements definition, part selection, detailed design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support of Cesium's products. Hardware design tasks will include block diagrams, detailed schematics, PCB layout and routing, simulations, and test design.   The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) from an accredited university or institution. 6+ years of industry experience in design and analysis of RF electronics design, analysis, test, and troubleshooting.  Experience with professional simulation tools such as CST and ADS, as well as EDA tools such Altium. Hands-on experience with lab instruments such as vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience with MATLAB or other programming languages. Experience in aerospace electronics design, development, and qualification. Knowledge of worst-case circuit analysis, failure method and criticality analyses, and reliability analysis. Experience with antenna design. Knowledge of EMI/EMC design and mitigation techniques. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organisation. Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.
